items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Could miss time with knee tendon issue
items.text:
Stevenson (knee) is dealing with a knee tendon issue that isn't slated to require surgery but may require him to miss "a short period of time," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carson Beck: Set to take over as QB1
items.text:
Beck is expected to start Sunday's contest against the Rams, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: George Pickens: Status for Week 10 remains uncertain
items.text:
Pickens (hamstring) has a chance to play Sunday against San Francisco, but his practice reps will likely again be capped this week, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Expected back after Week 11 bye
items.text:
Darnold (quadriceps), who won't play this coming Sunday at Las Vegas, is expected to return in Week 12 at San Francisco on Sunday, Nov. 29 after a Week 11 bye, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Managing hip issue
items.text:
McCarthy (hip) is listed as limited on Monday's practice estimate, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Deemed day-to-day by Harbaugh
items.text:
Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh noted Monday that McConkey is viewed as "day to day" with back spasms, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
